legs_na.onchain: MENGER holds no keys and signs nothing (INV-22). No contracts, no wallet, no signer.
legs_na.client_secrets: No client. No build-time secret injection surface.

findings.check: authz / IDOR on receipt and review reads
findings.detail: There is no authentication or authorization of any kind. Every endpoint is open and agent_id is an unauthenticated caller assertion. Any caller can read any receipt_id or review_id. This is recorded as a named exclusion in SECURITY.md, not as a passing check.
No keys, no credentials, no .env consumed by the engine. Corpus is synthetic and in-repo.
POST /receipts/{id}/replay is a deliberate, idempotent re-execution of recorded read statements through GRAPH.RO_QUERY. It cannot write. Divergence is reported, not suppressed.
Every value is a bound parameter; statements are module constants in app/cypher.py. No request field is interpolated into a query string.
429 RATE_LIMITED is defined in the error table and reserved. Enforcement is absent. Named in SECURITY.md.
Plain HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with CORS *. Acceptable for a local demonstration, unacceptable for anything reachable. Named in SECURITY.md.

note: No finding here is dismissed. The three NOT_DEFENDED/NOT_IMPLEMENTED rows are the same rows SECURITY.md lists under 'Not defended against' — the gate's output and the shipped doc agree by construction.
